brief: A patio bed for tomatoes and the plants that help them grow. A back row of three planters, each three storeys deep, with micro tomatoes in two of them and a pepper in the middle one; a low front row of three one-storey planters with basil, marigold and nasturtium. Fill every planter with soil and plant it.

finish.summary: Built a 6-cell patio bed: back row of three 3-storey tall planters (micro tomato, pepper, micro tomato) and front row of three 1-storey planters (basil, marigold, nasturtium), all filled with soil and planted, capped/locked and verified clear.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
